[[Amazon Eventbridge]] formerly known as CloudWatch Events, is a serverless task scheduler that simplifies creating, executing, and managing millions of schedules across AWS services without provisioning or managing underlying infrastructure.
- Serverless event bus for routing events from AWS services, custom apps, or SaaS tools to multiple targets based on rules.
